content: Supabase bulk insert: batch sizes of ~500-1000 rows per INSERT balance performance/memory; batching can be ~100x faster than row-by-row inserts. RLS policies are evaluated per row on insert, adding overhead at scale; for large import jobs prefer a privileged server-side path (service role key or a SECURITY DEFINER RPC) over relying on the client's RLS-scoped session per row. For very large imports (100k+ rows) COPY is recommended, but for MVP scale (hundreds of rows per import) plain batched inserts are sufficient.
